system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. You may make a [Safe Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. You gain a +[DEX base] bonus to the damage roll of a [Weapon Attack] done in this Main Process.

(Minor): Increase the distance moved by +1 Sq.

Special ability to move with a sharp step like lightning. Receives the momentum of god speed, doubling the power of subsequent attacks.
